akhfash:17-17.t: He said ﴿يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُواْ لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَداً﴾ because this is one of those (verbs) that are joined with lām; you say: "إِنْ عُدْتَ لِمَثْلِهِ فَإِنَّا ظَالِمٌ" (if you return to the like of it, then I am a wrongdoer). «[Translator's note: so in the text («فإنّا ظالم»).]»

akhfash:31-31.t: And He said ﴿أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُواْ﴾: He made ﴿الطِفْل﴾ (child) a plural, as He said ﴿وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ﴾ (they will turn their backs, with a singular noun).

akhfash:32-32.t: And He said ﴿مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ﴾, meaning "of your slaves" (مِنْ عَبِيدِكُم), just as you say: "هُمْ عِبَادُ اللهِ" and "عَبِيدُ اللهِ" (they are the servants of Allah).

akhfash:35-35.t:
And He said ﴿كَمِشْكَاةٍ﴾, i.e. like the likeness of a niche.
And He said ﴿كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ﴾ when he makes it from "الدُرّ" (pearls); and ﴿دِرِّيء﴾ from "دَرَأَ": he put hamza in it and made it of the pattern "فِعِّيل", and that is from its glittering. Some read ﴿دَرِّيٌ﴾, like ﴿فَعِّيل﴾.
As for ﴿مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ﴾: the lamp, in meaning, is that the likeness of the truth that He has illumined in His exposition is like the likeness of the niche. Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has no likeness.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿سُورَةٌ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هذه"; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْزَلْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective (ṣifa) of سورة. ﴿وَفَرَضْناها﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أنزلناها and parsed like it. ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا. ﴿آياتٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾: an adjective, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿الزَّانِيَةُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَالزَّانِي﴾: conjoined; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاجْلِدُوا﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِدٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْهُما﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word that is an] adjective of واحد. ﴿مِائَةَ﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object). ﴿جَلْدَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَأْخُذْكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the kāf is its object. ﴿بِهِما﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تأخذكم. ﴿رَأْفَةٌ﴾: postponed fāʿil. ﴿فِي دِينِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تأخذكم. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان (of kāna and its sisters) and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿تُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; [the two are] attached to تؤمنون. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; الآخر is grammatically an adjective (ṣifa) of اليوم, not a muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿وَلْيَشْهَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, [then] the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَذابَهُما﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿طائِفَةٌ﴾: postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to طائفة. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:3-4.t: ﴿الزَّانِي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لا يَنْكِحُ﴾: لا is negating, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿زانِيَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿مُشْرِكَةً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to زانية. ﴿وَالزَّانِيَةُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الزانية is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يَنْكِحُها﴾: لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿زانٍ﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿مُشْرِكٌ﴾: conjoined to زان. ﴿وَحُرِّمَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) حرم. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَرْمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الْمُحْصَناتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb jussive. ﴿يَأْتُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِأَرْبَعَةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتوا. ﴿شُهَداءَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of الذين. [Translator's note: the source calls the imperative "jussive" (majzūm); it is usually described as indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.] ﴿ثَمانِينَ﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural. ﴿جَلْدَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَقْبَلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقبلوا. ﴿شَهادَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَبَداً﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفاسِقُونَ﴾: khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:5-7.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿تابُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تابوا. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿وَأَصْلَحُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إنّ, the Name of Majesty its noun, and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَرْمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَزْواجَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لم makes the verb jussive. ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿شُهَداءُ﴾: the noun of يكن; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾: badal (substitute) for شهداء, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَشَهادَةُ﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَحَدِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَرْبَعُ﴾: khabar of شهادة. ﴿شَهاداتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين. [Translator's note: the source reads «خبر والذين», evidently for «خبر الذين».] ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and [the two are] attached to شهادات. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿وَالْخامِسَةُ﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and mubtadaʾ; the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). ﴿أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ﴾: أنّ and its noun. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أنّ and what follows it is the khabar. ﴿إِنْ كانَ﴾: إن is conditional, and كان is an incomplete past verb whose noun is omitted; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no position. [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of كان is usually taken as a latent (mustatir) pronoun "he".] ﴿مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:8-11.t:
﴿وَيَدْرَؤُا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿عَنْهَا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يدرأ. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْ تَشْهَدَ﴾: أن makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of nominative as fāʿil. ﴿أَرْبَعَ شَهاداتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾
﴿أَرْبَعَ﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object), and its i'rab is like its predecessor, no. 7. [Translator's note: the parallel phrase was parsed under verse 6.] ﴿وَالْخامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْها إِنْ كانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لولا is a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿فَضْلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل. ﴿وَرَحْمَتُهُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فضل, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أنّ, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: إنّ and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جاؤُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِالْإِفْكِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءوا; and الإفك is the lie. ﴿عُصْبَةٌ﴾: khabar of إنّ. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عصبة. ﴿لا تَحْسَبُوهُ﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its first object. ﴿شَرًّا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شرا. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُوَ خَيْرٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير. ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word that is a] fronted khabar. ﴿امْرِئٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of امرئ. ﴿مَا﴾: a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اكْتَسَبَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ الْإِثْمِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اكتسب. ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تولى. ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: an adjective of عذاب; the clause is the khabar of الذي.

daas-irab:12-14.t: ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ظن. ﴿سَمِعْتُمُوهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the wāw is for prolonging the ḍamma (lil-ishbāʿ); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِناتُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to المؤمنون. ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خيرا. ﴿خَيْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾: the hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِفْكٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging. ﴿جاؤُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءوا. ﴿بِأَرْبَعَةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءوا. ﴿شُهَداءَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿فَإِذْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذ is an adverb of time in the sense of إذا. ﴿لَمْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb jussive. ﴿يَأْتُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالشُّهَداءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتوا. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of إذ, and أولاء is mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address; the clause has no position because it is the answer of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to الفاسقون. [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in this verse is الكاذبون.] ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْكاذِبُونَ﴾: khabar. ﴿وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 11. [Translator's note: the phrase was parsed under verse 10.] ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رحمته. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿لَمَسَّكُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of لولا, and a past verb and its fronted object; the clause has no position because it is the answer of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿فِيما﴾: في is a preposition and ما is a relative noun; [the two are] attached to مسكم. ﴿أَفَضْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أفضتم. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: postponed fāʿil of مسكم. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: an adjective of عذاب.

daas-irab:15-18.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) مسكم. ﴿تَلَقَّوْنَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تلقونه. ﴿وَتَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿بِأَفْواهِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقولون. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علم. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾: the noun of ليس; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿هَيِّناً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to عظيم. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لَوْلا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 12. ﴿قُلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no position. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb. ﴿لَنا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb accusative. ﴿نَتَكَلَّمَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; أن and what follows it are in the position of nominative as the noun of يكون. ﴿بِهذا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نتكلم. ﴿سُبْحانَكَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بُهْتانٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the kāf is its fronted object and the Name of Majesty its postponed fāʿil. ﴿أَنْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb accusative. ﴿تَعُودُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لِمِثْلِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعودوا. ﴿أَبَداً﴾: an adverb of time, attached to تعودوا; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a conditional particle making the verb jussive, and كان (of kāna and its sisters), its noun and its khabar. ﴿وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبين. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and عليم حكيم are its two khabars; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:19-20.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of إنّ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يُحِبُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: [a particle] making the verb accusative. [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the verse is أَنْ.] ﴿تَشِيعَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن. ﴿الْفاحِشَةُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is in the position of genitive; [the two are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) تشيع; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and what follows it is the object of يحبون. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word that is a] fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عذاب. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الدنيا; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لولا is conditional, not making the verb jussive. ﴿فَضْلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فضل. ﴿وَرَحْمَتُهُ﴾: conjoined to فضل, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: أنّ, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: munādā (the one addressed in the vocative), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a vocative; the hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لا تَتَّبِعُوا﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿خُطُواتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿الشَّيْطانِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional [noun], mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتَّبِعْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿خُطُواتِ الشَّيْطانِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and إنّ and its noun; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿يَأْمُرُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿بِالْفَحْشاءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأمر. ﴿وَالْمُنْكَرِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الفحشاء. ﴿وَلَوْلا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 14. ﴿ما زَكى﴾: ما is negating, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to زكى. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾: fāʿil, genitive (majrūr) in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position. ﴿أَبَداً﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to زكى. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, the noun of لكنّ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُزَكِّي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إن الله سميع عليم﴾: إنّ, the Name of Majesty its noun, and سميع and عليم its two khabars; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:22-23.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لا is prohibitive. ﴿يَأْتَلِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿أُولُوا﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الْفَضْلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتل. ﴿وَالسَّعَةِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الفضل. ﴿أَنْ يُؤْتُوا﴾: أن makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿أُولِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْقُرْبى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). ﴿وَالْمَساكِينَ﴾: conjoined to القربى. [Translator's note: so in the source; grammatically والمساكين is accusative, conjoined to أولي.] ﴿وَالْمُهاجِرِينَ﴾: conjoined to المساكين. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to المهاجرين. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلْيَعْفُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلْيَصْفَحُوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَلا تُحِبُّونَ﴾: ألا is a particle of gentle request (ʿarḍ), and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb accusative. ﴿يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what follows it is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور and رحيم are its two khabars (predicates); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: إنّ, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يَرْمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْمُحْصَناتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿الْغافِلاتِ الْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾: adjectives (ṣifāt) of المحصنات. ﴿لُعِنُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to لعنوا. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾: an adjective; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:24-26.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of عذاب. ﴿تَشْهَدُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تشهد. ﴿أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ألسنتهم. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative [noun]; [the two are] attached to تشهد. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان (of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time, attached to يوفيهم. ﴿إذ﴾: an adverb of time in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fronted first object, with the Name of Majesty as its postponed fāʿil. ﴿دِينَهُمُ﴾: its second object. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: the khabar of أنّ. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾: an adjective. ﴿الْخَبِيثاتُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلْخَبِيثِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثاتِ﴾: its i'rab is like that of the preceding one; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَالطَّيِّباتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّباتِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُبَرَّؤُنَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: ما is a relative [noun], and [the two are] attached to مبرؤون. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَرِزْقٌ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾: an adjective of رزق.

daas-irab:27-28.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لا تَدْخُلُوا﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of بيوتا. ﴿بُيُوتِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿تَسْتَأْنِسُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the preposition and what follows it, [as] an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تدخلوا. ﴿وَتُسَلِّمُوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تدخلوا and parsed like it. [Translator's note: so in the source; تسلموا is conjoined to تستأنسوا, as its accusative form shows.] ﴿عَلى أَهْلِها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تسلموا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address.
﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إن is a conditional particle making the verb jussive. ﴿لَمْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb jussive. ﴿تَجِدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَحَداً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَدْخُلُوها﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿يُؤْذَنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after حتى, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤذن; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by حتى. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is the clause ارجعوا. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قيل. ﴿ارْجِعُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿فَارْجِعُوا﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿هُوَ أَزْكى لَكُمْ﴾: its i'rab is like that of ذلك خير لكم in the previous verse. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun; [the two are] attached to تعملون. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar.

daas-irab:29-30.t: ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿جُناحٌ﴾: the noun of ليس; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا﴾: أن is a particle making the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مَسْكُونَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مَتاعٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متاع; the clause is a second adjective of بيوتا. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تُبْدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما تَكْتُمُونَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it and parsed like it. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قل. ﴿يَغُضُّوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿أَبْصارِهِمْ﴾: genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَحْفَظُوا﴾: conjoined to يغضوا and parsed like it. ﴿فُرُوجَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿أَزْكى﴾: khabar, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾: the khabar of إنّ. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative noun, and [the two are] attached to يصنعون. ﴿يَصْنَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَقُلْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل. ﴿يَغْضُضْنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿أَبْصارِهِنَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), genitive (majrūr) in form, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَحْفَظْنَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يغضضن and parsed like it. ﴿فُرُوجَهُنَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿يُبْدِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿زِينَتَهُنَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], badal (substitute) for زينتهن. ﴿ظَهَرَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظهر. ﴿وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِخُمُرِهِنَّ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى جُيُوبِهِنَّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضربن, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبدين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿آبائِهِنَّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes and parsed like it. ﴿أَوْ آباءِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿بُعُولَتِهِنَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ أَبْنائِهِنَّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أَوْ أَبْناءِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿بُعُولَتِهِنَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ إِخْوانِهِنَّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أَوْ بَنِي﴾: conjoined to what precedes; it is genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِخْوانِهِنَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ بَنِي أَخَواتِهِنَّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes and parsed like it. ﴿أَوْ نِسائِهِنَّ﴾: conjoined to what precedes and parsed like it. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], conjoined to what precedes. ﴿مَلَكَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَيْمانُهُنَّ﴾: fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿غَيْرِ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of التابعين. ﴿أُولِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْإِرْبَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الرِّجالِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوِ الطِّفْلِ﴾: conjoined to الرجال. [Translator's note: so in the source; الطفل is conjoined to التابعين, as also understood in the other books.] ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, adjective. ﴿لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا﴾: لم makes the verb jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَلى عَوْراتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يظهروا. ﴿النِّساءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the prohibitive لا. ﴿يَضْرِبْنَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; it is in the position of jussive by the prohibitive لا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضربن. ﴿لِيُعْلَمَ﴾: the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and a passive imperfect verb, accusative; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the lām. ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun] in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿يُخْفِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the nūn is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ زِينَتِهِنَّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يخفين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَتُوبُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توبوا. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: munādā (the one addressed in the vocative) with an omitted vocative particle; it is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as a vocative; the hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: badal. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿تُفْلِحُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

daas-irab:32-33.t: ﴿وَأَنْكِحُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿الْأَيامى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالصَّالِحِينَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الأيامى, accusative like it, the sign of its accusative being an implied fatḥa on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible. [Translator's note: so in the source; الصالحين is a sound masculine plural, accusative with the yāʾ.] ﴿مِنْ عِبادِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِمائِكُمْ﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: conditional. ﴿يَكُونُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فُقَراءَ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿يُغْنِهِمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغنهم; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ واسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars. ﴿وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿لا يَجِدُونَ﴾: لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿نِكاحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿يُغْنِيَهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after حتى. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغنيهم. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the relative noun is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَبْتَغُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: من is a preposition and ما is a relative [noun]; [the two are] attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَكاتِبُوهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle making the verb jussive. ﴿عَلِمْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the protasis, with no position because it is initial. ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to علمتم. ﴿خَيْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَآتُوهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ مالِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آتوهم. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿آتاكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُكْرِهُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَياتِكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَى الْبِغاءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تكرهوا. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a conditional particle making the verb jussive. ﴿أَرَدْنَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause has no position because it is initial. ﴿تَحَصُّناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause of the answer is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿لِتَبْتَغُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after the lām of reason, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of genitive by the lām, and [the two are] attached to تكرهوا. ﴿عَرَضَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: an adjective, genitive with an implied kasra on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a conditional noun making the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُكْرِهْهُنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; it is the protasis; the clause is initial. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis, and إنّ and its noun; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿إِكْراهِهِنَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural. ﴿غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: two khabars of إنّ.

daas-irab:34-35.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is for the oath, the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause has no position because it occurs as the answer to the oath. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا. ﴿آياتٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مُبَيِّناتٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of آيات. ﴿وَمَثَلًا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آيات. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive; [the two are] attached to an omitted adjective of مثلا. ﴿خَلَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَوْعِظَةً﴾: conjoined to مثلا. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to موعظة. ﴿اللَّهُ نُورُ﴾
mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿نُورِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَمِشْكاةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is explicative (mufassira). ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مِصْباحٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمِصْباحُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي زُجاجَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الزُّجاجَةُ﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause is an adjective of زجاجة. ﴿كَأَنَّها﴾: كأنّ and its noun. ﴿كَوْكَبٌ﴾: the khabar of كأنّ; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿دُرِّيٌّ﴾: an adjective of كوكب. ﴿يُوقَدُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is a second adjective of كوكب. ﴿مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوقد. ﴿مُبارَكَةٍ﴾: an adjective of شجرة. ﴿زَيْتُونَةٍ﴾: badal (substitute) for شجرة. ﴿لا﴾: redundant (zāʾida). ﴿شَرْقِيَّةٍ﴾: a second adjective of شجرة. ﴿وَلا غَرْبِيَّةٍ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَكادُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿زَيْتُها﴾: the noun of يكاد, and the hā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يُضِيءُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the overt ḍamma, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of يكاد. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is a conditional particle that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ﴾: لم is a particle making the verb jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the hāʾ is its fronted object. ﴿نارٌ﴾: its postponed fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُورُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى نُورٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause emphasises what precedes it. ﴿يَهْدِي اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِنُورِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهدي, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْأَمْثالَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضرب. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:36-38.t: ﴿فِي بُيُوتٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb. ﴿أَذِنَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of بيوت. ﴿أَنْ تُرْفَعَ﴾: أن makes the verb accusative, and a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿وَيُذْكَرَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ترفع. ﴿فِيهَا﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يذكر. ﴿اسْمُهُ﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil of يذكر. ﴿يُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿لَهُ فِيها﴾: prepositions and their genitive nouns, attached to يسبح. ﴿بِالْغُدُوِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is a second adjective of بيوت. ﴿وَالْآصالِ﴾: conjoined to الغدو. ﴿رِجالٌ﴾: the fāʿil of يسبح. ﴿لا تُلْهِيهِمْ﴾: لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تِجارَةٌ﴾: postponed fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of رجال. ﴿وَلا بَيْعٌ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is redundant (zāʾida), and بيع is conjoined to تجارة. ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تلهيهم. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِقامِ﴾: conjoined to ذكر. ﴿الصَّلاةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِيتاءِ الزَّكاةِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَخافُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿يَوْماً﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to يخافون. ﴿تَتَقَلَّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تتقلب. ﴿الْقُلُوبُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَالْأَبْصارُ﴾: conjoined to القلوب. ﴿لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ﴾: the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after the lām of reason, and the hāʾ is a fronted first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَزِيدَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to يجزيهم and parsed like it. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يزيدهم. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿يَرْزُقُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يرزق. ﴿حِسابٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:39-40.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَسَرابٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause of الذين with its khabar is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بِقِيعَةٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of سراب. ﴿يَحْسَبُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object. ﴿الظَّمْآنُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿ماءً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a second adjective of سراب. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition. ﴿جاءَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمْ يَجِدْهُ﴾: لم is a particle making the verb jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent; the clause has no position because it is the answer of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to وجد, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَوَفَّاهُ حِسابَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object, its fāʿil being latent; حسابه is its second object, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ and khabar. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿كَظُلُماتٍ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كسراب. ﴿فِي بَحْرٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ظلمات. ﴿لُجِّيٍّ﴾: an adjective of بحر. ﴿يَغْشاهُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fronted object. ﴿مَوْجٌ﴾: postponed fāʿil; the clause is a second adjective of بحر. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَوْجٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is an adjective of موج. ﴿مِنْ فَوْقِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿سَحابٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the adjective of the second موج. ﴿ظُلُماتٌ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿بَعْضُها﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is an adjective of ظلمات. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to its answer. ﴿أَخْرَجَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يَدَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمْ يَكَدْ﴾: لم makes the verb jussive, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive by لم, whose noun is omitted. [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of يكد is usually taken as a latent pronoun.] ﴿يَراها﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of يكد. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional [noun] making the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ, and its clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّهُ﴾: لم makes the verb jussive, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجعل. ﴿نُوراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ما is negating; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ نُورٍ﴾: من is redundant (zāʾida); نور is mubtadaʾ, genitive (majrūr) in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position. The clauses of the condition and the answer are the khabar of من.

daas-irab:41-42.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; لم is a particle making the verb jussive. ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿يُسَبِّحُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿لَهُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسبح. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿وَالطَّيْرُ﴾: conjoined to من. ﴿صَافَّاتٍ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿صَلاتَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَسْبِيحَهُ﴾: conjoined to صلاته, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative [noun]; [the two are] attached to عليم. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a preposition and the Name of Majesty, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مُلْكُ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and لم makes the verb jussive. ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أنّ and its noun; it stands in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿يُزْجِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ. ﴿سَحاباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُؤَلِّفُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿بَيْنَهُ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤلف, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَجْعَلُهُ رُكاماً﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, its fāʿil being latent, and ركاما is its second object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَرَى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْوَدْقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; it is the rain. ﴿يَخْرُجُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ خِلالِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يخرج. ﴿وَيُنَزِّلُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يخرج and parsed like it. [Translator's note: so in the source; in sense ينزل is conjoined to يزجي, whose agent is Allah.] ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينزل. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿جِبالٍ﴾: genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِيها﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant preposition. ﴿بَرَدٍ﴾: genitive in form, nominative in position, as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of جبال. ﴿فَيُصِيبُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصيب. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَصْرِفُهُ﴾: conjoined to فيصيب. ﴿عَنْ مَنْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصرف. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَكادُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿سَنا﴾: the noun of يكاد, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بَرْقِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَذْهَبُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِالْأَبْصارِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the khabar of يكاد.

daas-irab:44-46.t: ﴿يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ﴾: an imperfect verb, the Name of Majesty its fāʿil (agent) and الليل its object; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ [Translator's note: no analysis is given for this word in the source; it is إنّ, the particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters).] ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَعِبْرَةً﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and عبرة is the noun of إنّ. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾: أولي is genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated like (mulḥaq bi-) the sound masculine plural; [the two are] attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عبرة. ﴿الْأَبْصارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿خَلَقَ كُلَّ﴾: a past verb and its object, the fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is the khabar. ﴿دَابَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ ماءٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلق. ﴿فَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative [noun], mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَمْشِي﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلى بَطْنِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يمشي, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى رِجْلَيْنِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى أَرْبَعٍ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾: إنّ, the Name of Majesty its noun and قدير its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير, and شيء is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause answering the oath has no position. ﴿آياتٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مُبَيِّناتٍ﴾: an adjective of آيات, accusative. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is omitted; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهدي. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: an adjective.

daas-irab:47-48.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and [the two are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا. ﴿وَبِالرَّسُولِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَطَعْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to آمنا. ﴿ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّى﴾: a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible. ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of فريق. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتولى. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما operates like ليس. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is in the position of nominative as its noun, and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and a noun genitive in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; it is the khabar (predicate) of ما. ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition, putting its protasis in the genitive [by annexation] and made accusative by its answer. ﴿دُعُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive by إلى; the two are attached to دعوا. ﴿والرسول﴾: conjoined to الله. ﴿لِيَحْكُمَ﴾: the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after the lām of reason, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), [with the preposition] are attached to دعوا. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to يحكم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذا﴾: [إذا] of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of فريق. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:49-51.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional. ﴿يَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: the noun of يكن, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿يَأْتُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتوا. ﴿مُذْعِنِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a masculine plural; the clause is the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ, with no position. ﴿أَفِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun are] attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَمِ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ارْتابُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَمِ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَخافُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾: [a particle] making the verb accusative. ﴿يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحيف. ﴿وَرَسُولُهُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative with the wāw; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿كانَ قَوْلَ﴾: كان (of kāna and its sisters) and its fronted khabar. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition. ﴿دُعُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive by إلى; the two are attached to دعوا. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أَنْ يَقُولُوا﴾: أن makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of nominative as the noun of كان. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأَطَعْنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 50.

daas-irab:52-53.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional [noun] making the verb jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يُطِعِ اللَّهَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its object being the Name of Majesty, and its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَخْشَ اللَّهَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the Name of Majesty is its object and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿وَيَتَّقْهِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, jussive like it. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْفائِزُونَ﴾: its i'rab is like that of أولئك هم المفلحون or الظالمون. ﴿وَأَقْسَمُوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أقسموا. ﴿جَهْدَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَيْمانِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is conditional. ﴿أَمَرْتَهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَيَخْرُجُنَّ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and an imperfect verb from which the wāw of the plural has been dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns; the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the nūn of the nominative has been dropped because of the succession of like [letters]; the clause has no position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تُقْسِمُوا﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿طاعَةٌ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي طاعة". ﴿مَعْرُوفَةٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ﴾: إنّ, its noun and its khabar; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no position. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative [noun]; [the two are] attached to the khabar. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.

daas-irab:54-55.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and إنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition. ﴿حُمِّلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَلَيْكُمْ ما﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿حُمِّلْتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional. ﴿تُطِيعُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; it is the protasis; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause is initial, with no position. ﴿تَهْتَدُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; it is the apodosis, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿عَلَى الرَّسُولِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, the Name of Majesty its fāʿil and the relative noun its object. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is its object and its fāʿil is latent; the clause has no position because it is the answer to an oath. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the preceding verb. ﴿كَمَا﴾: the kāf is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿اسْتَخْلَفَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of genitive by the kāf, and [the two are] attached to an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). [Translator's note: the source says «أن», but the particle here is the maṣdariyya ما.] ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ﴾: conjoined to ليستخلفنهم and parsed like it. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يمكنن. ﴿دِينَهُمُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, adjective of دين. ﴿ارْتَضى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif because [its pronunciation] is impossible, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ارتضى. ﴿وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ﴾: conjoined to ليمكنن and parsed like it; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the preceding verb. ﴿خَوْفِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَمْناً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَعْبُدُونَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the yāʾ its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and لا is negating. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِي﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يشركون. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional [noun], mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَعْدِ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to كفر. [Translator's note: so in the source; بعد here is an adverb of time.] ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis, and أولاء, the demonstrative, is mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفاسِقُونَ﴾: the khabar of أولئك; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition.

daas-irab:56-58.t:
﴿وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and الصلاة its object; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it and parsed like it. ﴿وَأَطِيعُوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes it and parsed like it. ﴿الرَّسُولَ﴾: conjoined to the earlier وأطيعوا الله. [Translator's note: so in the source; الرسول is the object of أطيعوا, and the clause as a whole recalls وأطيعوا الله in verse 54.] ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no position. ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لا تَحْسَبَنَّ﴾: لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مُعْجِزِينَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of تحسبن. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَأْواهُمُ النَّارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and المصير is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: parsed previously.
﴿لِيَسْتَأْذِنْكُمُ﴾: the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, and the kāf is its object. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as fāʿil. ﴿مَلَكَتْ أَيْمانُكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: conjoined to the preceding الذين. ﴿لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا﴾: لم makes the verb jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الْحُلُمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿ثَلاثَ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to يستأذنكم. ﴿مَرَّاتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي من قبل". ﴿صَلاةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْفَجْرِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَحِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an adverb of time. ﴿تَضَعُونَ ثِيابَكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; ثيابكم is mafʿūl bihi and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تضعون. ﴿وَمِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿صَلاةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعِشاءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثَلاثَ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي ثلاث". ﴿عَوْراتٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عورات. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جُناحٌ﴾: the noun of ليس. ﴿بَعْدَهُنَّ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to جناح, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; بعد here is an adverb of time.] ﴿طَوَّافُونَ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم طوافون". ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to طوافون; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَعْضُكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition and ذا is a demonstrative; [the two are] attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبين. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:59-60.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition. ﴿بَلَغَ الْأَطْفالُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْكُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْحُلُمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلْيَسْتَأْذِنُوا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of إذا, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no position because it is the answer of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿كَمَا﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿اسْتَأْذَنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb, and the relative noun is the fāʿil; ما and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of genitive by the kāf; [the two are] attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبين. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars (predicates);
