﴿ذلكم خير لكم لعلكم تذكرون﴾: (ذلكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (خير) is the khabar (predicate); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خير); the clause (ذلكم) is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لعل) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; and the clause (تذكرون) is the khabar of (لعل).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿فإن لم تجدوا فيها أحدا فلا تدخلوها حتى يؤذن لكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (تجدوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجدوا﴾; (أحدًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فلا تدخلوها﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تدخلوها) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the prohibitive lā; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يؤذن) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تدخلوها﴾; ﴿يؤذن﴾ is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤذن﴾.
﴿وإن قيل لكم ارجعوا فارجعوا هو أزكى لكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; ﴿قيل﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾; the clause (ارجعوا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فارجعوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a request; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أزكى لكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بما تعملون عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿بما تعملون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم); (عليم) is the khabar of (الله); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿ليس عليكم جناح أن تدخلوا بيوتا غير مسكونة فيها متاع لكم﴾: (ليس) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (ليس), placed first; (جناح) is its noun placed after; (أن) and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: in that you enter (في أن تدخلوا), and the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective (naʿt) of (جناح); (بيوتًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); (غير مسكونة) is an adjective of ﴿بيوتًا﴾; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; ﴿متاع﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (متاع); and the clause is a second adjective of ﴿بيوتًا﴾.
﴿والله يعلم ما تبدون وما تكتمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause (يعلم) is the khabar; (ما) is the direct object; the clause (تبدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; the clause ﴿والله يعلم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; and ﴿وما تكتمون﴾ is conjoined to (ما تبدون).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم ويحفظوا فروجهم﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿للمؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; ﴿يغضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by an implied (muqaddar) lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; omitting the lām is permissible because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.
Or: ﴿يغضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb in the jussive as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, and the implied form of the speech is: say to the believers, "Lower your gaze and guard your private parts" (غُضُّوا من أبصاركم واحفظوا فروجكم), [and] they will lower their gaze and guard their private parts.
Or: ﴿يغضوا﴾ is an imperfect verb diverted from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿غضوا﴾, and it is made indeclinable (mabnī) because it occupies the place of an indeclinable form, so its nūn is dropped.
﴿من أبصارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغضوا﴾, and the attached pronoun is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ويحفظوا﴾ is conjoined to (يغضوا); and ﴿فروجهم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ذلك أزكى لهم﴾: ﴿ذلك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أزكى﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أزكى﴾; and the nominal clause is resumptive and causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله خبير بما يصنعون﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is the noun of (إن); ﴿خبير﴾ is the khabar of (إن); ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, i.e.: of what they do (بالذي يصنعونه); or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from ﴿ما يصنعون﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ, i.e.: of their doing (بصنعِهم); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿خبير﴾; the clause ﴿يصنعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿إن الله خبير...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the meaning may be: hoping for your success, in which case the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of (توبوا). [Translator's note: this last alternative ("hoping for your success … ḥāl of the agent of توبوا") does not fit this ayah; it belongs to (لعلكم تفلحون) after (وتوبوا) in the next ayah (24:31) and appears to have been carried over from there.]

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وقل للمؤمنات يغضضن من أبصارهن ويحفظن فروجهن﴾: ﴿وقل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قل) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿للمؤمنات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; the clause ﴿قل للمؤمنات﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause ﴿قل للمؤمنين﴾; ﴿يغضضن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) by an implied (muqaddar) lām of command; omitting the lām is permissible because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil.
Or: ﴿يغضضن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the implied form is: and say to the believing women, "Lower your gaze, guard your private parts and do not display …" (اغضضْن من أبصاركن واحفظْن فروجكن ولا تبدين ...), [and] they will lower their gaze, guard their private parts and not display … (يغضضن من أبصارهن ويحفظن فروجهن ولا يبدين....).
Or: ﴿يغضضن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and it has been diverted from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿اغضضْن﴾.
﴿من أبصارهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغضضن﴾, and the attached pronoun is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ويحفظن﴾ is conjoined to (يغضضن); and ﴿فروجهن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا يبدين زينتهن إلا ما ظهر منها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of prohibition; ﴿يبدين﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on an implied sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive lā; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يبدين﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغضضن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is in the jussive by an implied lām of command or stands in the place of a command meaning (اغضضْن), and it is conjoined to the implied object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) ﴿اغضضْن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is the answer to the command ﴿قل﴾.
﴿زينتهن﴾ is the direct object; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, a badal (substitute) for (زينتهن); and the clause ﴿ظهر منها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.
﴿وليضربن بخمرهن على جيوبهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ليضربن﴾: the lām is the lām of command; (يضربن) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive by the lām of command; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿ليضربن﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغضضن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is in the jussive by an implied lām of command or stands in the place of a command meaning (اغضضْن), and it is conjoined to the implied object of the saying ﴿اغضضْن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾. ﴿بخمرهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضربن﴾, and ﴿على جيوبهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضربن﴾.
﴿ولا يبدين زينتهن إلا لبعولتهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the i'rab of ﴿لا يبدين﴾ is like the i'rab of the earlier ﴿لا يبدين﴾ in this ayah; ﴿زينتهن﴾ is the direct object; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction; and ﴿لبعولتهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبدين﴾.
﴿أو آبائهن أو آباء بعولتهن أو أبنائهن أو أبناء بعولتهن أو إخوانهن أو بني إخوانهن أو بني أخواتهن أو نسائهن أو ما ملكت أيمانهن﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿بعولتهن﴾.
﴿أو التابعين غير أولي الإربة من الرجال أو الطفل الذين لم يظهروا على عورات النساء﴾: ﴿أو التابعين﴾ is also conjoined to ﴿بعولتهن﴾; ﴿غير﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of (التابعين); ﴿أولي﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿الإربة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من الرجال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿أو الطفل﴾ is also conjoined, and it means "children", so the ﴿أل﴾ is generic; ﴿الذين﴾ is an adjective; the clause ﴿لم يظهروا﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; ﴿على عورات النساء﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يظهروا﴾; and (النساء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولا يضربن بأرجلهن ليعلم ما يخفين من زينتهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of prohibition; ﴿يضربن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive lā; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يضربن﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يغضضن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is in the jussive by an implied lām of command or stands in the place of a command meaning (اغضضْن), and it is conjoined to the implied object of the saying ﴿اغضضْن﴾ if the verb ﴿يغضضن﴾ is the answer to the command ﴿قل﴾. ﴿بأرجلهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضربن﴾; ﴿ليعلم﴾: the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl), and ﴿يعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām, and it is built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the causal lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to ﴿يضربن﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿يخفين﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يخفين﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; the pronoun returning to ﴿ما﴾ is omitted, the implied form being: so that what they hide be known (ليعلم ما يخفينه); and ﴿من زينتهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the omitted returning pronoun, which is the object of (يخفين).
﴿وتوبوا إلى الله جميعا أيها المؤمنون لعلكم تفلحون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or the wāw is a conjunction joining it to the clause ﴿قل للمؤمنين﴾; ﴿توبوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ﴿إلى الله﴾: (إلى) is a preposition, the Name of Majesty is a noun in the genitive by (إلى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿توبوا﴾; ﴿جميعًا﴾ is a ḥāl; ﴿أيها﴾: (أيُّ) is the one addressed in the vocative, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, ﴿ها﴾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the vocative particle is omitted; ﴿المؤمنون﴾ is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾; ﴿لعلكم﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the pronoun of the addressees is in the position of the accusative as the noun of (لعل); the clause ﴿تفلحون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (لعل); and the clause ﴿لعلكم تفلحون﴾ is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وأنكحوا الأيامى منكم والصالحين من عبادكم وإمائكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الأيامى) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وأنكحوا الأيامى﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الصالحين) is conjoined to (الأيامى); (من عبادكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and (إمائكم) is conjoined to (عبادكم).
﴿إن يكونوا فقراء يغنهم الله من فضله والله واسع عليم﴾: (إن) is conditional; (يكونوا) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its noun, and (فقراء) is its khabar (predicate); (يغنهم الله) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (من فضله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغنهم﴾; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (واسع) is a first khabar, and (عليم) is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وليستعفف الذين لا يجدون نكاحا حتى يغنيهم الله من فضله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; (يستعفف) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (الذين) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (لا يجدون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (نكاحًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يغنيهم) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستعفف﴾; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and (من فضله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغنيهم﴾.
﴿والذين يبتغون الكتاب مما ملكت أيمانكم فكاتبوهم إن علمتم فيهم خيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الذين) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is the clause (فكاتبوهم); the clause (يبتغون الكتاب) is the ṣila of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause (ملكت أيمانكم) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; the fāʾ is a linking one because of the hint of condition in the relative noun; (كاتبوهم) is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿هم﴾ is the direct object; the clause is the khabar; (إن) is conditional; (علمتم) is a past verb and its fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (فيهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿علمتم﴾; (خيرًا) is the direct object; and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by His words (فكاتبوهم).
﴿وآتوهم من مال الله الذي آتاكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (آتوهم) is conjoined to (فكاتبوهم); ﴿من مال الله﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿آتوهم﴾; (الذي) is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿لله﴾; and the clause (آتاكم) is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) and has no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تكرهوا فتياتكم على البغاء إن أردن تحصنا لتبتغوا عرض الحياة الدنيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تكرهوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the prohibitive lā; (على البغاء) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تكرهوا﴾; (إن) is conditional; (أردن) is a past verb and its fāʿil, in the position of the jussive as the protasis; (تحصنًا) is a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) [Translator's note: so in the source; (تحصنًا) is more naturally the direct object of (أردن)]; the apodosis is omitted; ﴿لتبتغوا﴾: the lām is causal, (تبتغوا) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and ﴿عرض الحياة الدنيا﴾ are the direct object and the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ومن يكرههن فإن الله من بعد إكراههن غفور رحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ; (يكرههن) is the protasis; the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ, because the apodosis is a nominal clause; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿من بعد إكراههن﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; (غفور) is the first khabar of (إن), and (رحيم) is its second khabar; and the clause ﴿يكرهن﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿ولقد أنزلنا إليكم آيات مبينات ومثلا من الذين خلوا من قبلكم وموعظة للمتقين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (أنزلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إليكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (آيات) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ولقد أنزلنا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; (مبينات) is an adjective (naʿt); (مثلًا) is conjoined to (آيات); ﴿من الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿مثلًا﴾; the clause (خلوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; ﴿من قبلكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (موعظة) is conjoined to ﴿مثلًا﴾; and ﴿للمتقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (موعظة).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿نور﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿السماوات﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined to (السماوات).
﴿مثل﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿نوره﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿كمشكاة﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿مشكاة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar placed first.
﴿مصباح﴾: a mubtadaʾ placed after. The clause ﴿فيها مصباح﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of (مشكاة). The clause ﴿مثل نوره﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿المصباح﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿في زجاجة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar. The clause ﴿المصباح في زجاجة﴾ is in the position of the nominative as an adjective of ﴿مصباح﴾.
﴿الزجاجة﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿كأنها﴾: (كأن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and ﴿ها﴾ is its noun.
﴿كوكب﴾: its khabar.
﴿دري﴾: an adjective of (كوكب). The clause ﴿كأنها كوكب﴾ is the khabar of (الزجاجة). The clause ﴿الزجاجة كأنها...﴾ is in the position of the genitive as an adjective of ﴿زجاجة﴾.
﴿يوقد﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). The clause ﴿يوقد﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of ﴿مصباح﴾, or in the position of the nominative as an adjective of ﴿مصباح﴾.
﴿من شجرة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوقد﴾.
﴿مباركة﴾: an adjective of (شجرة).
﴿زيتونة﴾: a badal (substitute) for ﴿شجرة﴾; it has also been said: an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it.
﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿شرقية﴾: a second adjective of ﴿شجرة﴾, or an adjective of ﴿زيتونة﴾. ﴿لا﴾ has entered upon the adjective to convey negation.
﴿ولا غربية﴾: conjoined to ﴿شرقية﴾.
﴿يكاد﴾: a defective imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba).
﴿زيتها﴾: the noun of ﴿يكاد﴾, and ﴿ها﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿يضيء﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent. The clause ﴿يضيء﴾ is the khabar of ﴿يكاد﴾.
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is a wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial). (لو) is a non-jussive conditional particle.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive.
﴿تمسسه﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾. The answer of (لو) is omitted because what precedes indicates it, the implied form being: it would have shone (لأضاء); and the clause ﴿لو لم تمسسه نار﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of ﴿يضيء﴾.
﴿نار﴾: the fāʿil of ﴿تمسسه﴾.
﴿نور﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: this to which the truth has been likened is a multiplied light (هذا الذي شبهت به الحق نور متضاعف).
﴿على نور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿نور﴾ that emphasises it. The clause ﴿نور على نور﴾ is resumptive and emphatic, with no grammatical position, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the phrase "with no grammatical position" is repeated in the source.]
﴿يهدي﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma. The clause ﴿يهدي الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿لنوره﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يهدي﴾.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the object of (يهدي).
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent. The clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويضرب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يضرب) is an imperfect verb in the nominative.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil.
﴿الأمثال﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿يضرب الله الأمثال﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يهدي﴾.
﴿للناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضرب﴾.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction. (الله) is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿بكل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليم﴾.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿عليم﴾: khabar, nominative. The clause ﴿والله بكل شيء عليم﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause, or is itself resumptive; on both views it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿في بيوت أذن الله أن ترفع ويذكر فيها اسمه﴾: ﴿في بيوت﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (مشكاة), i.e.: like a niche situated in houses (كمشكاة مستقرة في بيوت), or of (مصباح), or of (زجاجة); or attached to ﴿يوقد﴾; or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: glorify Him in houses (سبحوه في بيوت), or (يسبح); the clause ﴿أذن الله﴾ is an adjective of (بيوت); (أن) and what falls within its scope are accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: in that they be raised (في أن ترفع); ﴿ويذكر﴾ is conjoined to (ترفع), built for that whose agent is not named (passive); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذكر﴾; and ﴿اسمه﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿يسبح له فيها بالغدو والآصال﴾: the clause is a second adjective of (بيوت); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسبح﴾; ﴿بالغدو والآصال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (الآصال) is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿رجال لا تلهيهم تجارة ولا بيع عن ذكر الله وإقام الصلاة وإيتاء الزكاة﴾: (رجال) is the fāʿil (agent) of (يسبح); the clause (لا تلهيهم) is an adjective (naʿt) of (رجال); (تجارة) is the fāʿil of (تلهيهم); (ولا بيع) is conjoined to (تجارة); ﴿عن ذكر الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تلهيهم﴾, and the Name of Majesty is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and what follows is conjoined to ﴿ذكر الله﴾.
﴿يخافون يوما تتقلب فيه القلوب والأبصار﴾: the clause is a second adjective of (رجال), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of (تلهيهم); (يخافون) is a verb and its fāʿil; (يومًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (تتقلب) is an adjective of ﴿يومًا﴾; (فيه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تتقلب﴾; (القلوب) is the fāʿil of (تتقلب); and (الأبصار) is conjoined to (القلوب).

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ليجزيهم الله أحسن ما عملوا ويزيدهم من فضله﴾: the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (يجزيهم) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخافون﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); (أحسن) is the second object; (ما) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (عملوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; (يزيدهم) is conjoined to (ليجزيهم); and (من فضله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يزيدهم﴾.
﴿والله يرزق من يشاء بغير حساب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (يرزق) is the khabar (predicate); (من) is the direct object; the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾ and has no grammatical position; (بغير حساب) is a ḥāl; and the clause ﴿والله يرزق...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿والذين كفروا أعمالهم كسراب بقيعة يحسبه الظمآن ماء حتى إذا جاءه لم يجده شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الذين) is a first mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; (أعمالهم) is a second mubtadaʾ; ﴿كسراب﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ, and (سراب) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the second mubtadaʾ and its khabar are the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿والذين كفروا...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يحسبه الظمآن﴾ is an adjective (naʿt) of (سراب); ﴿ماء﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (يحسبه); ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and of the genitive; ﴿إذا﴾ is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿جاءه﴾ is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; the clause ﴿لم يجده﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; and ﴿شيئًا﴾ is the second object of (يجده).
﴿ووجد الله عنده فوفاه حسابه والله سريع الحساب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (وجد) is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); the Name of Majesty is the direct object; (عنده) is an accusative adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object of (وجد). ﴿فوفاه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (وفاه) is a verb, a latent agent and a first object; (حسابه) is the second object; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ; and ﴿سريع الحساب﴾ are the khabar and the muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿أو كظلمات في بحر لجي يغشاه موج من فوقه موج من فوقه سحاب﴾: (أو) is a conjunction; ﴿كظلمات﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the kāf in ﴿كسراب﴾; and ﴿سراب﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source, apparently carried over from the previous ayah; here the muḍāf ilayhi of the kāf is (ظلمات)]; ﴿في بحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (ظلمات); ﴿لجي﴾ is an adjective of (بحر); the clause ﴿يغشاه موج﴾ is a second adjective of (بحر), and (موج) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من فوقه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (موج) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, and the clause is an adjective of the first (موج); and the clause ﴿من فوقه سحاب﴾ is an adjective of the second (موج).
﴿ظلمات بعضها فوق بعض إذا أخرج يده لم يكد يراها﴾: (ظلمات) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: these are layers of darkness (هذه ظلمات). (بعضها) is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿فوق بعض﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause is an adjective of (ظلمات). The clause ﴿ظلمات...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position. (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition, attached to the apodosis; the clause (أخرج) is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; the fāʿil of (أخرج) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; (يده) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (يكد) is a defective imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause (يراها) is the khabar of (يكد); and the clause (لم يكد يراها) has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ومن لم يجعل الله له نورا فما له من نور﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive; (يجعل) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second object; (نورًا) is the first object of ﴿يجعل﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis because it is a nominal clause; (ما) is negative; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (من) is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; (نور) is genitive in form and nominative in position as the mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿ومن لم يجعل...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يسبح له من في السماوات والأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the hamza is interrogative; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (تر) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (أن) and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of (تر); the clause (يسبح) is the khabar (predicate); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسبح﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil of (يسبح); ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿والطير صافات كل قد علم صلاته وتسبيحه والله عليم بما يفعلون﴾: the wāw is for conjunction; (الطير) is conjoined to (من); (صافات) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the object of (صافات) is omitted, i.e.: spreading their wings (باسطات أجنحتها); (كل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿قد علم﴾ is the khabar of (كل); the agent of (علم) refers to (كل), or to Allah; (صلاته) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (تسبيحه) is conjoined to (صلاته); (الله) is a mubtadaʾ, and (عليم) is the khabar; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم); and the clause (يفعلون) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ولله ملك السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; and ﴿ملك السماوات والأرض﴾ are a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after and its muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإلى الله المصير﴾: ﴿إلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first, and (المصير) is a mubtadaʾ placed after.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يزجي سحابا ثم يؤلف بينه ثم يجعله ركاما﴾: the hamza is interrogative; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to past meaning) and jussive; (تر) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (أن) and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of (تر); (ثم) is a conjunction; (يؤلف) is conjoined to (يزجي); (بينه) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤلف﴾; (ثم) is a conjunction; (يجعله) is an imperfect verb, a latent agent and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (ركامًا) is the second object.
﴿فترى الودق يخرج من خلاله﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿ترى الودق﴾ is an imperfect verb, a latent agent, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and a direct object; the clause (يخرج) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿من خلاله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرج﴾.
﴿وينزل من السماء من جبال فيها من برد﴾: the first (من) marks the starting point (ibtidāʾiyya), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ينزل﴾; (الجبال) is a genitive noun, a badal (substitute) for (السماء) with repetition of the governing word; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (جبال); ﴿من برد﴾: (من) is partitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted object of ﴿ينزل﴾, the implied form being: and He sends down some hail from the sky, from its mountains (ويُنَزِّلُ بعضَ بردٍ من السماء مِن جبالِها).
﴿فيصيب به من يشاء ويصرفه عن من يشاء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (يصيب) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring to Allah; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يصيب﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the direct object; and the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿ويصرفه عمن يشاء﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿يكاد سنا برقه يذهب بالأبصار﴾: (يكاد) is an imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba); (سنا) is its noun, and (برقه) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يذهب﴾ is its khabar (predicate); and ﴿بالأبصار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذهب﴾.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿يقلب الله الليل والنهار﴾: (يقلب) is an imperfect verb. The Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) of (يقلب). (الليل) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (النهار) is conjoined to (الليل). The clause ﴿يقلب الله...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿إن في ذلك لعبرة لأولي الأبصار﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿عبرة﴾ is its noun placed after; ﴿لأولي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (عبرة). (الأبصار) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿والله خلق كل دابة من ماء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (خلق) is the khabar (predicate); ﴿كل دابة﴾ are the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿من ماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلق﴾.
﴿فمنهم من يمشي على بطنه﴾: the fāʾ is for branching off (tafrīʿiyya); (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (من) is a mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause (يمشي) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; and (على بطنه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمشي﴾.
﴿ومنهم من يمشي على رجلين ومنهم من يمشي على أربع﴾: conjoined.
﴿يخلق الله ما يشاء إن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: ﴿يخلق الله ما يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its direct object; the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; ﴿إن الله﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿على كل شيء﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (قدير); and (قدير) is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿لقد أنزلنا آيات مبينات والله يهدي من يشاء إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (أنزلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (آيات) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (مبينات) is an adjective (naʿt); (الله) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (يهدي) is its khabar (predicate); (مَن) is the direct object; the clause (يشاء) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾ and has no grammatical position; ﴿إلى صراط﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يهدي﴾; and (مستقيم) is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ويقولون آمنا بالله وبالرسول وأطعنا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (يقولون) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) and its fāʿil (agent); the clause (آمنا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (آمنا) is a verb and its agent; (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾; ﴿بالرسول﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بالله﴾; and (أطعنا) is conjoined to (آمنا).
﴿ثم يتولى فريق منهم من بعد ذلك وما أولئك بالمؤمنين﴾: (ثم) is a conjunction; (يتولى) is an imperfect verb in the nominative; (فريق) is the fāʿil; (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt); ﴿من بعد ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the demonstrative refers to the aforementioned saying; the wāw is a wāw of ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative (mā) that governs like (ليس); ﴿أولئك﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as the noun of (ما); ﴿بالمؤمنين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿المؤمنين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ; and the clause is a ḥāl clause.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وإذا دعوا إلى الله ورسوله ليحكم بينهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; (دعوا) is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إلى الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دعوا﴾; (رسوله) is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (يحكم) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿دعوا﴾; and (بينهم) is an adverb attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿إذا فريق منهم معرضون﴾: (إذا) is the (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and it has taken the place of the fāʾ in linking the apodosis to its condition; (فريق) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt); and (معرضون) is the khabar (predicate) of (فريق).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وإن يكن لهم الحق يأتوا إليه مذعنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (يكن) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (يكن), placed first; (الحق) is its noun placed after; ﴿يأتوا﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتوا﴾ or to ﴿مذعنين﴾.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿أفي قلوبهم مرض أم ارتابوا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the hamza is interrogative; ﴿في قلوبهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (مرض) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; (أم) is a conjunction, of the disjoined kind (munqaṭiʿa), meaning (بل) plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being: nay, have they doubted? (بل أرتابوا؟); the interrogation here is for affirmation and reproach; and (ارتابوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿أم يخافون أن يحيف الله عليهم ورسوله بل أولئك هم الظالمون﴾: ﴿أم يخافون﴾ is conjoined to what preceded; ﴿أن يحيف﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يخافون﴾; (بل) is a particle of turning away (iḍrāb); (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ; (هم) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ; (الظالمون) is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ — or it is the khabar of (أولئك).

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿إنما كان قول المؤمنين إذا دعوا إلى الله ورسوله ليحكم بينهم﴾: (إنما) is a restraining particle and the one it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (كان) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); (قول) is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), placed first; (المؤمنين) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; the clause (دعوا) is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿إلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دعوا﴾; (رسوله) is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (يحكم) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿دعوا﴾; and (بينهم) is an adverb attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿أن يقولوا سمعنا وأطعنا وأولئك هم المفلحون﴾: (أن) and what falls within its scope are the noun of (كان); the clause (سمعنا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (أطعنا) is conjoined to (سمعنا); the wāw is a conjunction; (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (هم) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ; and (المفلحون) is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, or the khabar of (أولئك).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿ومن يطع الله ورسوله ويخش الله ويتقه فأولئك هم الفائزون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يطع) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); (رسوله) is conjoined to ﴿الله﴾; ﴿يتقه﴾ is conjoined to (يطع); and the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أولئك هم الفائزون﴾: (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ; (هم) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ; (الفائزون) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ — or it is the khabar of (أولئك).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وأقسموا بالله جهد أيمانهم لئن أمرتهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (أقسموا) is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بالله) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسموا﴾; ﴿جهد﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: they swore by Allah, exerting themselves in their oaths; or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the meaning of the maṣdar (verbal noun), the meaning being: they swore an oath of exertion in swearing. ﴿أيمانهم﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لئن﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and (إن) is conditional. ﴿أمرتهم﴾ is a verb, its agent and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ليخرجن قل لا تقسموا طاعة معروفة إن الله خبير بما تعملون﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; (يخرجن) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the nūn having been dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because two sukūns met, is the fāʿil; and the nūn is for emphasis; (قل) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تقسموا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (طاعة) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "your affair" (أمركم), i.e.: your affair that is required of you is a known obedience; or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: a known obedience is more fitting for you. ﴿معروفة﴾ is an adjective (naʿt); the clause (إن الله) gives the reason for what preceded; (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and (خبير) is the khabar of (إن); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خبير); and the clause (تعملون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿قل أطيعوا الله وأطيعوا الرسول﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿أطيعوا﴾ is an imperative verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: so in the source; the agent of (أطيعوا) is the overt wāw of the plural, not a latent pronoun], and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (أطيعوا الرسول) is conjoined to ﴿أطيعوا الله﴾.
﴿فإن تولوا فإنما عليه ما حمل وعليكم ما حملتم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (تولوا) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been dropped. ﴿فإنما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the apodosis is omitted, i.e.: if you turn away from obedience, then know that upon him is only what he has been charged with (إن تتولوا عن الطاعة فاعلموا أنما عليه ما حمل); (إنما) is a restraining particle and the one it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; ﴿ما حمل﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause (حمل) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; and ﴿وعليكم ما حملتم﴾ is conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وإن تطيعوه تهتدوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (تطيعوه) is the protasis, and it is a verb, its agent and its direct object; and (تهتدوا) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ المبين﴾: the wāw is a wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive; (ما) is negative; ﴿على الرسول﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar placed first; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (البلاغ) is a mubtadaʾ placed after; (المبين) is an adjective (naʿt); and the clause ﴿وما على الرسول﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, or is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وعد الله الذين آمنوا منكم وعملوا الصالحات ليستخلفنهم في الأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿وعد الله الذين﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (آمنوا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to (آمنوا); the second object of (وعد) is omitted, its implied form being "succession" (الاستخلاف), because His words ﴿ليستخلفنهم﴾ indicate it; the lām is the answer to an implied oath, i.e.: I swear He will surely make them successors (أقسم ليستخلفنهم); (في الأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستخلفنهم﴾; or (وعد) is treated as equivalent to (أقسم).
﴿كما استخلف الذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: He will surely make them successors with a succession like the succession of those before them (ليستخلفنهم استخلافًا مثلَ استخلاف الذين من قبلهم); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming; ﴿استخلف﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ and what follows it is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿الذين﴾ is the object of (استخلف); and ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of (الذين), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وليمكنن لهم دينهم الذي ارتضى لهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ليمكنن) is conjoined to (ليستخلفنهم), so it is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمكنن﴾; (دينهم) is the direct object; (الذي) is an adjective; the clause (ارتضى) is the ṣila of (الذي) and has no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun is omitted, i.e.: (ارتضاه); and ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ارتضى﴾.
﴿وليبدلنهم من بعد خوفهم أمنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ليبدلنهم) is conjoined to what preceded; the hāʾ is the first object; ﴿من بعد خوفهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and (أمنًا) is the second object.
﴿يعبدونني لا يشركون بي شيئا﴾: the clause ﴿يعبدونني﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; it has also been said that it is a ḥāl of the object of (وعد), or of the object of ﴿ليستخلفنهم﴾; the clause ﴿لا يشركون بي شيئًا﴾ is a ḥāl of the agent of (يعبدونني), i.e.: they worship Me, affirming My oneness. ﴿شيئًا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, or it is a direct object.
﴿ومن كفر بعد ذلك فأولئك هم الفاسقون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (مَن) is a conditional mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفر) is a past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (بعد ذلك) is an adverb attached to ﴿كفر﴾; (فأولئك هم الفاسقون) — the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis; (أولئك) is a demonstrative, a mubtadaʾ; (هم) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and (الفاسقون) is the khabar (predicate); or ﴿هم الفاسقون﴾ are a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the khabar of (أولئك); the two clauses of the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن كفر...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿وأقيموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة وأطيعوا الرسول لعلكم ترحمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿أقيموا الصلاة﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وأقيموا الصلاة...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿وآتوا الزكاة وأطيعوا الرسول﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أقيموا الصلاة﴾; (لعل) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; and the clause (ترحمون) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿لا تحسبن الذين كفروا معجزين في الأرض ومأواهم النار﴾: (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تحسبن) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (الذين) is the first object of (تحسبن); the clause (كفروا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (معجزين) is the second object of (تحسبن); and ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (معجزين). ﴿ومأواهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (مأواهم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (النار) is its khabar (predicate), or the reverse.
﴿ولبئس المصير﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; (بئس) is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb of blame; (المصير) is the fāʿil; and the one specifically blamed (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "the Fire" (النار).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا ليستأذنكم الذين ملكت أيمانكم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the lām is the lām of command; (يستأذنكم) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذين) is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿ملكت أيمانكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position.
﴿والذين لم يبلغوا الحلم منكم ثلاث مرات من قبل صلاة الفجر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (الذين) is conjoined to (الذين); the clause (لم يبلغوا الحلم) is the ṣila of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (ثلاث) is accusative as an adverb, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the number of the maṣdar (verbal noun); (مرات) is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿من قبل صلاة الفجر﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted badal (substitute) for ﴿ثلاث مرات﴾, or to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: they are before (هن من قبل).
﴿وحين تضعون ثيابكم من الظهيرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (حين) is conjoined to the position of ﴿من قبل صلاة الفجر﴾; the clause (تضعون) is genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; (ثيابكم) is the direct object; and ﴿من الظهيرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: at the time of that hour which is midday; or to ﴿تضعون﴾, in which case ﴿من﴾ means "in" (في).
﴿ومن بعد صلاة العشاء ثلاث عورات لكم﴾: ﴿ومن بعد صلاة العشاء﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿ثلاث عورات﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, after which a muḍāf is implied whose place the muḍāf ilayhi has taken, i.e.: they are the times of three exposures (هي أوقات ثلاث عورات).
﴿ليس عليكم ولا عليهم جناح بعدهن طوافون عليكم بعضكم على بعض﴾: the clause ﴿ليس عليكم ...﴾ etc. is an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿ثلاث عورات﴾, the meaning being: ﴿هن ثلاث عورات مخصوصة بالاستئذان﴾ (they are three times of exposure singled out for asking permission); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of (ليس), placed first; (جناح) is its noun placed after; (بعدهن) is an adverb attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿جناح﴾; (طوافون) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being ﴿هم﴾; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿طوافون﴾; (بعضكم) is a mubtadaʾ; and ﴿على بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, i.e.: going round to others (طائف على بعض).
﴿كذلك يبين الله لكم الآيات والله عليم حكيم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e.: with an explanation like that does Allah explain the signs to you (تبيينًا مثل ذلك يبين الله لكم الآيات); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿الآيات﴾ is the direct object; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿عليم﴾ is a first khabar, and ﴿حكيم﴾ is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وإذا بلغ الأطفال منكم الحلم فليستأذنوا كما استأذن الذين من قبلهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; the clause ﴿بلغ الأطفال﴾ is genitive because (إذا) is annexed to it; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الحلم) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ links the answer of (إذا); the lām is the lām of command; (يستأذنوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (naʿt) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming; ﴿استأذن﴾ is a past verb; ﴿الذين﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: asking permission like the asking of permission of those before them (استئذانًا مثل استئذان الذين من قبلهم); and ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته والله عليم حكيم﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e.: with an explanation like that does Allah explain His signs to you (تبيينًا مثل ذلك يبين الله لكم آياته); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿آياته﴾ is the direct object; ﴿الله﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عليم﴾ is a first khabar (predicate), and ﴿حكيم﴾ is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿والقواعد من النساء اللاتي لا يرجون نكاحا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (القواعد) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من النساء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (اللاتي) is an adjective (naʿt) of (القواعد); the clause (لا يرجون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾ and has no grammatical position. (يرجون) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil (agent); and (نكاحًا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فليس عليهن جناح أن يضعن ثيابهن غير متبرجات بزينة﴾: the fāʾ is connective (ṣila); the clause ﴿ليس﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿القواعد﴾; ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of (ليس), placed first; (جناح) is its noun placed after; (أن) and what falls within its scope are in the place of the accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: in that they put aside their garments (في أن يضعن ثيابهن); ﴿غير متبرجات﴾ is a ḥāl; (بزينة) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (متبرجات); it has been said that the bāʾ has the meaning of the lām, i.e.: not displaying for adornment (غير مظهرات لزينة); and it has been said that it is for making the verb transitive (taʿdiya), i.e.: not displaying adornment (غير مظهرات زينة). The clause ﴿والقواعد من النساء...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن يستعففن خير لهن والله سميع عليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أن) and what falls within its scope are a mubtadaʾ, and (خير) is the khabar; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خير); (الله) is a mubtadaʾ; (سميع) is a first khabar, and (عليم) is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿ليس على الأعمى حرج﴾: (ليس) is a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters); ﴿على الأعمى﴾ is its khabar (predicate) placed first; (حرج) is its noun placed after; ﴿لا على الأعرج حرج﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it, and likewise what follows it.
﴿ولا على أنفسكم أن تأكلوا من بيوتكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; (لا) is negative; (على أنفسكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar placed first; (أن) and what falls within its scope are a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; and (من بيوتكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تأكلوا﴾.
﴿أو بيوت آبائكم﴾: also conjoined to what precedes.
﴿أو بيوت أخوالكم﴾: also conjoined to what precedes.
﴿أو ما ملكتم مفاتحه أو صديقكم﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to what precedes; the clause (ملكتم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position; (مفاتحه) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; and (صديقكم) is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ليس عليكم جناح أن تأكلوا جميعا أو أشتاتا﴾: the clause is a badal (substitute) for the preceding clause; (أن تأكلوا): (أن) and what falls within its scope are accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: in that you eat (في أن تأكلوا); (جميعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and (أشتاتًا) is conjoined to (جميعًا).
﴿فإذا دخلتم بيوتا فسلموا على أنفسكم تحية من عند الله مباركة طيبة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; the clause (دخلتم) is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; (بيوتًا) is accusative as an object by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa). ﴿فسلموا﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; (سلموا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (على أنفسكم) is attached to ﴿سلموا﴾; (تحية) is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) drawn from the meaning of (فسلموا); ﴿من عند الله﴾ is attached to an omitted adjective (naʿt) of (تحية); (مباركة) is an adjective, and (طيبة) is also an adjective.
﴿كذلك يبين الله لكم الآيات لعلكم تعقلون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e.: with an explanation like that does Allah explain the signs to you (تبيينًا مثل ذلك يبين الله لكم الآيات); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿الآيات﴾ is the direct object; ﴿لعلكم﴾: ﴿لعل﴾ is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), the kāf is the noun of (لعل), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; and the clause ﴿تعقلون﴾ is the khabar of (لعل).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿إنما المؤمنون الذين آمنوا بالله ورسوله﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; (إنما) is a restraining particle and the one it restrains (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (المؤمنون) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الذين) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿آمنوا بالله ورسوله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا كانوا معه على أمر جامع لم يذهبوا حتى يستأذنوه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; the clause (كانوا) is in the position of the genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; the wāw is the noun of (كان); (معه) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar; ﴿على أمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (جامع) is an adjective (naʿt) of (أمر); the clause (لم يذهبوا) has no grammatical position because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يستأذنوه) is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied (أن) after (حتى); (يستأذنوه) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from (أن) and the verb is genitive by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يذهبوا﴾.
﴿إن الذين يستأذنونك أولئك الذين يؤمنون بالله ورسوله﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (of inna and its sisters), and (الذين) is its noun; the clause (يستأذنونك) is the ṣila of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (أولئك) is a mubtadaʾ, and (الذين) is its khabar; the clause ﴿يؤمنون بالله ورسوله﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun and has no grammatical position; and the nominal clause is the khabar of (إن).
﴿فإذا استأذنوك لبعض شأنهم فأذن لمن شئت منهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا) is a future adverb carrying the meaning of a condition; the clause (استأذنوك) is genitive because the adverb is annexed to it; (لبعض شأنهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استأذنوك﴾, serving as the reason for asking permission; ﴿فَأْذَنْ﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of (إذا), and (أذن) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; the clause (شئت) is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾ and has no grammatical position; and (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿واستغفر لهم الله إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (استغفر) is conjoined to ﴿فَأْذَنْ﴾; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استغفر﴾; and the clause ﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾ is the reason for seeking forgiveness, so it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿لا تجعلوا دعاء الرسول بينكم كدعاء بعضكم بعضا﴾: (لا) is the lā of prohibition; (تجعلوا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (دعاء الرسول) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بينكم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿كدعاء﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the second object, and ﴿دعاء﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بعضكم) is muḍāf ilayhi; and (بعضًا) is the object of (دعاء).
﴿قد يعلم الله الذين يتسللون منكم لواذا﴾: (قد) is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); ﴿يعلم الله﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; (الذين) is the direct object; the clause (يتسللون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين) and has no grammatical position; (منكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتسللون﴾; and (لواذًا) is accusative as an absolute object (maṣdariyya), or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl, i.e.: taking shelter behind one another (ملاوذين).
﴿فليحذر الذين يخالفون عن أمره أن تصيبهم فتنة أو يصيبهم عذاب أليم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "disclosing" fāʾ); the lām is the lām of command; (يحذر) is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām of command; (الذين) is the fāʿil; the clause (يخالفون) is the ṣila of (الذين), and the object of (يخالفون) is omitted, namely Allah the Exalted; ﴿أن تصيبهم﴾ is the object of (يحذر); (فتنة) is the fāʿil; and ﴿أو يصيبهم عذاب أليم﴾ is conjoined to (أن تصيبهم فتنة).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿ألا إن لله ما في السماوات والأرض قد يعلم ما أنتم عليه﴾: (ألا) is a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh) and opening (istiftāḥ); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن), placed first; (ما) is its noun placed after; ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; (قد) is for frequency (al-takthīr); (يعلم) is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring to Allah the Exalted; (ما) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أنتم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾ and has no grammatical position.
﴿ويوم يرجعون إليه فينبئهم بما عملوا والله بكل شيء عليم﴾: ﴿ويوم﴾ is conjoined to the object of ﴿يعلم﴾, i.e.: and He knows the day they are returned (ويعلم يوم يرجعون); (يرجعون) is built for that whose agent is not named (passive); (فينبئهم) is conjoined to (يعلم), and the hāʾ is the direct object; ﴿بما عملوا﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element in the place of the second object; (الله) is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿بكل شئ﴾ — the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (عليم); and (عليم) is the khabar.

nahhas-irab:37-37.t:
«وَإِقامِ الصَّلاةِ»: one says أقام الصلاة إقامة ("he performed the prayer, a performing"). The original is إقوامة: the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the qāf, so the wāw turned into an alif; after it came [another] alif, and both were quiescent, so one of them was dropped, and the hāʾ [the feminine ending] was kept so that you would not drop it as well and thereby mutilate the word. When you put it in construct (iḍāfa), the muḍāf ilayhi took the place of the hāʾ, so dropping it became permissible; if you do not put it in construct, dropping it is not permissible. Do you not see that you say وعد عدة ("he promised, a promise"), and dropping the hāʾ is not permissible, because you have already dropped a wāw — the original being وعدة — but if you put it in construct, dropping the hāʾ becomes permissible. Al-Farrāʾ recited: [al-Basīṭ metre] 307-
إنّ الخليط أجدّوا البين فانجردوا ... وأخلفوك عد الأمر الّذي وعدوا
(The companions resolved in earnest on parting and hastened away, and broke with you the promise of the matter they had promised.)
He means عدة, and dropped the hāʾ because he put it in construct. «يَخافُونَ يَوْماً تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصارُ»: we have already mentioned this. It was said: its meaning is that the hearts of the wicked will turn about upon the Fire; and it was said: «تتقلّب» means they are roasted once and the Fire scorches them once [again].

nahhas-irab:39-39.t: «وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «أَعْمالُهُمْ» is a second mubtadaʾ. It may also be a badal (substitute) for «الذين», and the khabar (predicate) is then «كَسَرابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْآنُ ماءً». If you lighten the hamza, you say «الظّمآن». [Translator's note: the printed text shows the same spelling الظّمآن for the lightened form; the intended form (presumably الظَّمَانُ, without the hamza) is not distinguished in the source.]

nahhas-irab:40-40.t:
«ظُلُماتٌ» is on the basis of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject). Whoever reads «ظلمات» [in the genitive] makes it a badal (substitute) for the first «ظلمات». One also says «ظلمات» [ẓulamāt] because of the lightness of the fatḥa, and «ظلمات» [ẓulmāt] to avoid the heaviness of the ḍamma. [Translator's note: the source prints these variants without the vowelling that distinguishes them; the readings in brackets are the ones evidently intended.]
«وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ نُوراً فَما لَهُ مِنْ نُورٍ»: Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] interpreted it as referring to this world, i.e. whoever Allah has not granted guidance to Islam will not be guided. Others interpreted it as referring to the Hereafter, i.e. whoever Allah has not granted a light on the Day of Resurrection will not find the way to Paradise.

nahhas-irab:41-41.t:
[«وَالطَّيْرُ» is nominative] as maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «من». [Translator's note: the beginning of this entry, naming the word discussed, is missing in the source; it evidently concerns «وَالطَّيْرُ صَافَّاتٍ».] Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] said: «والطير» [in the accusative] is also permissible, in the sense of "with the birds", but it has not been read so. Abū Jaʿfar said: I heard him permit قمت وزيدا ("I stood up, and Zayd [with me]") in the sense of "with Zayd". He said: this is better than the nominative. He said: but if you say قمت أنا وزيد ("I myself and Zayd stood up"), the nominative is better, though the accusative is permissible.
«كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ»: the meaning may be: "each — Allah knows its prayer and its glorification". From this angle, putting «كلّ» in the accusative is permissible according to the Basrans and the Kufans. Abū Isḥāq said: prayer belongs to human beings, and glorification belongs to others as well as to them. The meaning may also be: "each knows its own prayer and its glorification".

nahhas-irab:43-43.t:
«أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحاباً ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ»: it may be asked: «بين» ("between") is only used of two or more, so how does «بينه» ("between it") come here? The answer is that «بينه» here refers to the collective [mass] of clouds, as you say: الشجر حسن، وقد جلست بينه ("the trees are fine, and I sat among them"). There is another view: that «السحاب» is singular, yet it is permissible to say «بينه» because it comprises many pieces, as the poet said: [al-Ṭawīl metre] 308-
قفا نبك من ذكرى حبيب ومنزل ... بسقط اللّوى بين الدّخول فحومل
(Halt, the two of you, and let us weep at the memory of a beloved and a dwelling, at the edge of the winding sand between al-Dakhūl and Ḥawmal.)
He used «بين» with «الدخول», which is a single [place], because it comprises several spots. This is the view of the grammarians, except al-Aṣmaʿī, who claimed that this is not permissible and used to transmit it as «بين الدّخول وحومل» [with wāw instead of fāʾ].
Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Ḍaḥḥāk read «فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلالِهِ» ] [i.e. من خَلَلِه]. [Translator's note: the source prints the standard reading «خِلالِهِ» followed by a stray bracket; the variant being described is evidently من خَلَلِه, as the following sentence shows.] خلل is the singular of خلال, like جمل and جمال; it is a singular that indicates a plural.
«وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّماءِ مِنْ جِبالٍ فِيها مِنْ بَرَدٍ»: whoever says the meaning is "from mountains of hail in it", «برد» for him is in the position of the genitive (khafḍ) — this is what al-Farrāʾ says — as you say: الإنسان من لحم ودم ("man is of flesh and blood") and الإنسان لحم ودم ("man is flesh and blood"). On his view the meaning must be "from mountains, hail, in it", with tanwīn on «الجبال», because he said: the mountains are the hail. On the view of the Basrans, «من برد» is in the position of the accusative, and the genitive is also permissible, as you say: مررت بخاتم حديدا and بخاتم حديد ("I passed by a ring of iron"): the genitive is as a badal (substitute), and the accusative is, according to Sībawayh, as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and according to Abū al-ʿAbbās [al-Mubarrad] as explanation (bayān).
Whoever says the meaning is "from the quantity of mountains", «من برد» for him is in the position of the accusative and nothing else. Al-Farrāʾ said:
as you say عندي بيتان تبنا ("I have two houses' worth of straw"); and like it, in his view, is «أَوْ عَدْلُ ذلِكَ صِياماً» [al-Māʾida: 95]. Whoever says:
«من» is redundant (zāʾida) in both places, both are for him in the position of the accusative and nothing else.
Abū Jaʿfar [al-Qāriʾ] read «يَكادُ سَنا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصارِ» with ḍamma on the yāʾ [i.e. يُذهِب]. Abū Ḥātim claimed that this is a solecism (laḥn), and this is the view of his teacher al-Akhfash: one says دخل بالمدخل ("he entered with the one entering"), and [al-Akhfash] does not permit أدخل here, and claims that the bāʾ alternates with the alif [of the causative form IV]. This is the clear view. But as for it being an error that is not permissible and cannot be accounted for — a group has claimed that the bāʾ may be redundant, and they cited as proof the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: «وَمَنْ يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحادٍ بِظُلْمٍ» [al-Ḥajj: 25], although a view other than this is more appropriate than it, namely what ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān related to us from Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad]. He said: the bāʾ is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun), since the verb indicates it and is derived from it; on this basis the implied meaning is "its going away with the sights" or "its taking away [of the sights]". Likewise: أدخل بالمدخل السّجن الدار [sic] is permissible on this basis. [Translator's note: the example is printed as given; its wording appears garbled in the source.]

nahhas-irab:44-44.t: «يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ» is figurative (majāz), i.e. He turns this into that and that into this; when one of them departs and the other enters, it is as though it were what [the first] was turned into.

nahhas-irab:45-45.t:
«وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِنْ ماءٍ»: [this is] the reading of the Medinans, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim and the rest of the Kufans; [others] read «خالق كلّ دابّة» ("the Creator of every creature"). [Translator's note: as printed, the sentence attributes «خالق» to "the Medinans, Abū ʿAmr, ʿĀṣim and the rest of the Kufans", which cannot be right, since these read «خَلَقَ»; «خالق» is the reading of Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī. The text appears to have lost a phrase; the bracketed words follow the evident sense.] Both meanings are sound: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has given two pieces of information, and it should not be said here that one of the two readings is more correct than the other, because they indicate two meanings. But if someone were to say: «خلق» is more frequent in this [kind of context], because it is not something specific — «خالق» is said in the general sense, as He, Mighty and Majestic, said: «الْخالِقُ الْبارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ» [al-Ḥashr: 24], while in specific contexts [it is] «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ» [al-Anʿām: 1], and likewise «هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ واحِدَةٍ» [al-Aʿrāf: 189] — then likewise it should be «وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِنْ ماءٍ».
«الدابّة» is every animal that creeps (dabba) upon the earth; one says دبّ, and he is داب, and the hāʾ is for intensiveness (mubālagha). It was said: by "water" here is meant semen, as He said: «مِنْ ماءٍ دافِقٍ» [al-Ṭāriq: 6]. It was said: since the creation of the earth was from water, this came thus. And it was said: the origin of the creation of fire and light is from water.
«فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى أَرْبَعٍ»: whatever walks on more than four, walks on four. Rational beings were given precedence [in the use of «من»] when they were combined with non-rational ones, because they are the ones addressed and charged with worship.

nahhas-irab:49-49.t: «مُذْعِنِينَ» is in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

nahhas-irab:50-50.t: «أَفِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتابُوا»: Allah rebuked them for that, in view of the proofs He had made manifest, and said: «بَلْ أُولئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ».

nahhas-irab:51-51.t: Al-Ḥasan read «إِنَّما كانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ» [i.e. قولُ, in the nominative], making it the noun (ism) of «كان», with the khabar (predicate) being «أَنْ يَقُولُوا». [Translator's note: the source prints the standard vowelling «قَوْلَ» while describing al-Ḥasan's nominative reading.]

nahhas-irab:53-53.t:
«قُلْ لا تُقْسِمُوا»:
He forbade them from swearing, because their intention was otherwise, so they would be sinful if they swore. «طاعَةٌ مَعْرُوفَةٌ»
is on the basis of an implied "let there be obedience"; the meaning may also be: "obedience is more fitting for you".
Abū Isḥāq [al-Zajjāj] said: «طاعة» in the accusative is permissible, meaning as a maṣdar (verbal noun) [i.e. mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object)].

nahhas-irab:54-54.t: «فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا» is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) by the condition. The original is تتولّوا: one of the two tāʾs was dropped because the other indicates it, and the nūn was dropped for the jussive. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is in the fāʾ and what follows it.

nahhas-irab:55-55.t:
In this verse there is an indication of the prophethood of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, because Allah fulfilled that promise; and there is in it an indication of the caliphate of Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān and ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with them, because He did not appoint as successors any of those addressed by this verse other than them, since this verse was revealed before the conquest of Mecca.
It is reported from the Prophet ﷺ that he said: "The caliphate after me is thirty [years]" — this is in accordance with the verse.
«وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْناً»: ʿĀṣim reads «وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ» with the lighter form [i.e. وليُبْدِلنّهم]. Muḥammad ibn al-Jahm related from al-Farrāʾ that he said:
ʿĀṣim and al-Aʿmash read «وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ» with the doubled form. This is a mistake about ʿĀṣim, and we have mentioned after it a mistake graver than it, namely that he reported the lighter form from the rest of the people. [Translator's note: the source prints «وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ» with shadda in all three places, so the light and doubled forms being contrasted are not distinguished in the printed text.] Abū Jaʿfar said: Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā [Thaʿlab] claimed that there is a difference between the lighter and the doubled form, and that one says بدّلته meaning "I changed it", and أبدلته meaning "I removed it and put something else [in its place]". Abū Jaʿfar said: this view is correct, as you say: أبدل لي هذا الدرهم, i.e. "remove it and give me another", and you say: قد بدّلت بعدنا, i.e. "you have changed [since we left]"; yet one of them is sometimes used in place of the other, though what he mentioned is more common.
«يَعْبُدُونَنِي» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it may also be resumptive (mustaʾnaf), in the position of the nominative.

nahhas-irab:57-57.t:
«لا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ»: [«الذين» and «معجزين» are] two objects. Ḥamza read «لا يحسبنّ الذين كفروا معجزين في الأرض» [with yāʾ]. Abū Jaʿfar said: I know of no one among the people of Arabic grammar and lexicography, Basran or Kufan, who does not forbid reading this reading.
